title: customer-zenith-incident-timeline-draft-olivia-park
content:
Purpose: scratchpad for internal timeline + commands tried. Draft of short customer-facing summary at bottom.

Overview:
- Customer: Zenith (large B2B SaaS) reported intermittent 502s and garbled token output from model route `rw/open-7b-quant` starting ~2025-11-02 14:10 UTC.
- Impact: elevated error rate ~3-5% on traffic to their tenant; spikes correlated with specific request shapes (long prefix + tool-calls).

Timeline (events & notes):
2025-11-02 14:07 UTC: First Pager alert (error-rate > 1% threshold).
2025-11-02 14:10 UTC: Customer support thread created (Slack thread ID in linked_artifacts).
2025-11-02 14:12 UTC: Eng on-call (Olivia) triaged; collected sample request IDs.
  - sample request id: req-zn-000411-a1b2c3
  - sample timestamp: 2025-11-02T14:09:58Z

Commands run / quick checks (raw):
- curl to hosted API (sanitized token):
  curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"rw/open-7b-quant","input":"<truncated prefix>...","max_tokens":256}' \
    https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
  -> got HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway intermittently (3/10 attempts)

- kubectl logs on pod handling req-zn-000411-a1b2c3:
  kubectl -n dedicated-zenith logs inference-serve-1 -c runtime | sed -n '1,200p'
  -> snippets: "[2025-11-02T14:09:58Z] ERROR runtime: kv_cache mismatch for shard=2, expected 0x7f1a, got 0x0000"
  -> also saw CUDA OOM on one tail request: "CUDA error: out of memory (700)" but not correlated with all 502s.

- checked model variant routing:
  GET /internal/route?tenant=zenith&model=rw/open-7b-quant -> routed to pool dedicated-zenith-1 (gpu: a40), fallback policy: none (dedicated).

- Replayed failing request locally against same model binary (container image tag: rw/open-7b-quant:v2025-10-28):
  - Local run produced garbled tokens (repeated control chars) and then halted with runtime assertion:
    AssertionError: KVCache::read() inconsistent length (expected 24192, got 0)

Observed error snippets (copied raw):
- "runtime: failed to deserialize KV cache: invalid header magic 0x0000 at offset 0"
- "[handler] write: broken pipe"
- "Traceback (most recent call last):
    File "/opt/runtime/serve.py", line 412, in handle_request
      vec = model.generate(prefix, max_tokens=256)
    File "/opt/runtime/model.py", line 289, in generate
      restore_kv_cache(kv_blob)
  RuntimeError: KVCache header mismatch"

Hypotheses so far (ordered by likelihood):
1) KV cache serialization bug in rw/open-7b-quant:v2025-10-28 causing invalid headers for certain prefix lengths (observed in assertion and deserialize errors).
2) A hot-path race when restoring cached KV between concurrent requests on same shard causing partial writes (broken pipe, inconsistent lengths).
3) Under-provisioned GPU memory during large-prefix tool-call workloads leading to OOM and subsequent corrupted state (less likely because corruption seen even when OOM not present).
4) Network/proxy between runtime and cache service intermittently truncating blobs (unlikely: cache is local to node).

Immediate mitigation steps attempted:
- Rolled traffic for tenant Zenith to a safe model variant rw/open-7b-quant:v2025-09-12 (older stable) at 2025-11-02 16:30 UTC -> error rate dropped to baseline within 12 minutes.
- Put a temporary request-size guard (reject requests with prefix > 12000 tokens for Zenith) at 2025-11-02 16:45 UTC.
- Restarted affected inference pods (2 pods) to flush local caches at 2025-11-02 17:02 UTC.

Root-cause investigative notes:
- Repro locally with a constructed request that triggers cache restore after a tool call and long prefix; identical binary shows KV header mismatch reproducible ~1/4 runs.
- Diffs between v2025-10-28 and v2025-09-12 show changes in KV serialization ordering for attention layers 4-6 (PR#893 linked). Suspect an endian/packing regression introduced in PR#893.
- Coverage: unit tests for KV serialization exist but do not cover multi-shard concurrent restores; need integration test.

Next steps (owner tags):
- [Olivia] Cut a hotfix branch reverting PR#893 packing change -> run unit+integration (target: 2025-11-05 EOD).
- [Evan] Add integration test to reproduce multi-shard KV restore race, add to CI (target: 2025-11-07).
- [Priya] Coordinate with Customer Success for communication and make rollback + safety knobs available for Dedicated tenants (in progress).
- [Maya] Validate no other tenants on same bin using v2025-10-28 are seeing issues (target: 2025-11-06).

Draft internal summary (to CSM / Eng lead):
- Brief: Intermittent 502s for Zenith caused by corrupted KV cache headers during restore on rw/open-7b-quant:v2025-10-28. Rolling back to v2025-09-12 stabilized requests. Investigating serialization change (PR#893) as likely regression. Hotfix and integration tests in progress.

Draft customer-facing note (short):
Hi Team Zenith,

Thanks again for flagging this — we traced the issue to a problem in how the inference runtime was restoring internal KV cache state for longer-prefix requests. We rolled your traffic to a stable model variant and added temporary request-size protections; you should see normal behavior now. Our engineers are preparing a hotfix (expected in the next 72 hours) and will follow up once deployed. Apologies for the disruption — we appreciate the patience.

If you want, we can schedule a 30-min postmortem walkthrough.

— Olivia (on-call eng)
customer_facing_draft:
Hi Zenith team,

Thanks for reporting the issue. We investigated and found a bug in the runtime that can corrupt cached state for long-prefix requests; we've routed your traffic to a stable model variant and implemented temporary request-size protections. We're deploying a hotfix and expect to finish verification within 72 hours. We'll keep you updated and can set up a short call if helpful.

Apologies for the disruption,
Olivia Park, Redwood Inference
